description: Use this when the person starts, finishes or skips a session, or says how it felt. status IN_PROGRESS starts it, DONE finishes it and SKIPPED skips it; feeling is 1 to 5; notes and gym as they say. Null leaves a field as it is. Comes back with an Undo. Do not use to move a session to another day; use move_session.

feeling.description: How it felt, 1 to 5; an empty string clears it, null leaves it.

gym.description: The gym they trained at, as they name it; null leaves it.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

notes.description: Their notes on the session; an empty string clears them, null leaves them.

sessionId.description: The session's id, from get_today or get_schedule.

status.description: IN_PROGRESS starts it, DONE finishes it, SKIPPED skips it, PLANNED puts it back; null leaves it.

name: update_session
title: Start or finish a session
